source_title: NMAC 18.19.8 — Movement of Oversize/Overweight Vehicles; NMSA 1978 Sec. 66-7-413 (fees)
verify_reasons: Overweight single-trip fee is a weight-distance formula read from NMSA 1978 Sec. 66-7-413 statute text via a non-official mirror (state Justia/Ports-of-Entry portal 403-blocked this run); confirm the exact current per-increment rate through the NM MVD permit portal.

New Mexico's NMAC defines no fixed dimensional 'superload' category; only a weight trigger (bridge review at/above 200,000 lbs, engineering analysis above 170,000 lbs) is codified, so width/height/length superload thresholds are null and the handler flags very large dimensions for manual review.
Standalone semitrailer length is not published as a discrete number (NMAC governs by 65' overall combination); the 53' national-network default is used for the length field.

superload_thresholds.note: NMAC has no fixed dimensional superload class. Gross weight at/above 200,000 lbs is routed to the NMDOT Bridge Section for structural review; engineering analysis is required above 170,000 lbs (NMAC 18.19.8.40). Extreme dimensions (e.g. width 20'+) are handled case-by-case, not by a published dimensional threshold.

width.note: escort required at/over 14' wide; single escort travels front on two-lane, rear on multilane (NMAC 18.19.8.81/.92.G)
state police escort may be required over 20' wide (NMAC 18.19.8.84)

height.note: escort or a height-clearance/pole person may be required over 16' high (NMAC 18.19.8.83)

single_trip.fee_formula: Oversize single trip = $25. Overweight single trip = $25 + ($0.025 x each 2,000-lb increment (or major fraction) of gross weight over 86,400 lbs x number of miles traveled) per NMSA 1978 Sec. 66-7-413. Example: 100,400 lbs over 50 mi = $25 + (0.025 x 7 x 50) = $33.75.
single_trip.note: Weight-distance overweight fee; specialized-haul multiple-trip permit is $400 for 4 contiguous counties + 3 interstates, plus $100 per additional county.

annual.note: Annual OS/OW permit $250 (up to one year, NMSA 66-7-413); specialized-haul multiple-trip permit $400+ (NMAC 18.19.8.55.B).

movement_restrictions: Daylight movement only — no movement from 30 minutes after sunset to 30 minutes before sunrise (NMAC 18.19.8.24)
No movement on state-designated holidays or in inclement weather (NMAC 18.19.8.24)

Metro weekday rush-hour bans: Santa Fe, Las Cruces, Los Lunas, Espanola no movement 7:00-9:00 AM and 4:00-6:00 PM; Albuquerque and Rio Rancho no movement 7:00-9:00 AM and 4:00-7:00 PM (NMAC 18.19.8.26)
Continuous 24-hour movement allowed only for loads at or under 10' wide, 14'6" high, 120' long and 140,000 lbs (NMAC 18.19.8.25); still no holiday or inclement-weather travel
notes: Legal width 8'6" on designated highways, height 14'0", gross 80,000 lbs (up to 86,000 lbs with certain axle configurations per NMSA 66-7-409); single-vehicle length 40', combination 65' (NMAC 18.19.8.37).
Escort matrix, curfews and legal limits confirmed from the official NMAC (srca.nm.gov); overweight fee formula and annual fee confirmed from NMSA 66-7-413 statute text.
